rows.speaker: LOUDSPEAKER
rows.hi: "लल्लन की मिठाई में आधी चीनी, आधी चालाकी!"
rows.text: In Lallan's sweets, there is half sugar and half cheating!
rows.back_en: At Lallan's sweet shop, it's half sugar and half cheating!

rows.speaker: LALLAN
rows.hi: अरे! ये किसने बोला?
rows.text: Arey! Who said that just now?
rows.back_en: Hey! Who just said that?

rows.speaker: LALLAN
rows.hi: मैं तो… मैं तो बस मन में सोच रहा था!
rows.text: But I... I was only thinking this in my head!
rows.back_en: But I... I was only thinking this in my head!

rows.speaker: TITLE CARD
rows.hi: सुबह — मेले से पहले
rows.text: Morning — Just before the fair
rows.back_en: Morning — Just before the fair

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: चाचा! आज कौन-सी मशीन बना रहे हो?
rows.text: Chacha! Which new machine are you building today?
rows.back_en: Uncle! What new machine are you building today?

rows.speaker: JUGAADU CHACHA
rows.hi: ये है… "दिल की बात रेडियो"! जिसकी तरफ़ घुमाओ, उसके दिल की आवाज़ सुनाई देगी।
rows.text: This is... the 'Heart's Voice Radio'! Just point it at anyone, and you can hear their secret thoughts!
rows.back_en: This is... the 'Heart's Voice Radio'! Just point it at anyone, and you can hear their secret thoughts!

rows.speaker: JUGAADU CHACHA
rows.hi: पर पहले देखो मेरी "बोलती कुकर"! ये बताती है कि दाल कब पकेगी।
rows.text: But first, look at my brand new 'Talking Cooker'! It tells you exactly when the dal is ready.
rows.back_en: But first, look at my brand new 'Talking Cooker'! It tells you exactly when the lentils are ready.

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: चाचा, ये बोलती कैसे है?
rows.text: Chacha, how does it talk like this?
rows.back_en: Uncle, how does it talk like this?

rows.speaker: GUDIYA
rows.hi: <laugh> चाचा, आपकी कुकर तो बोलने से पहले सबको नहला गई!
rows.text: <laugh> Chacha, your talking cooker gave us all a bath before saying anything!
rows.back_en: <laugh> Uncle, your talking cooker soaked us all before saying anything!

rows.speaker: JUGAADU CHACHA
rows.hi: हें हें… इसका गुस्सा थोड़ा तेज़ है। चलो, असली मशीन देखो!
rows.text: Hehe... its anger is a bit too much, yaar. Come on, look at the real machine!
rows.back_en: Hehe... it has a bit of a temper, buddy. Come on, look at the real machine!

rows.speaker: GUDIYA
rows.hi: दिल की आवाज़? चाचा, दिल तो धक-धक करता है, बात थोड़ी करता है!
rows.text: Heart's voice? Chacha, the heart only goes dhak-dhak, it doesn't really talk!
rows.back_en: Heart's voice? Uncle, the heart only goes thump-thump, it doesn't really talk!

rows.speaker: JUGAADU CHACHA
rows.hi: करता है, बिटिया। बस कोई सुनता नहीं।
rows.text: It does, beta. It's just that nobody listens.
rows.back_en: It does, child. It's just that nobody listens.

rows.speaker: JUGAADU CHACHA
rows.hi: देखो! पहला टेस्ट — शेरू!
rows.text: Look! Our very first test — Sheru!
rows.back_en: Look! Our very first test — Sheru!

rows.speaker: RADIO
rows.hi: मुझे भी लड्डू चाहिए! एक नहीं, दो!
rows.text: I also want sweet laddus! Not just one, but two!
rows.back_en: I also want sweet treats! Not just one, but two!

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: हाहाहा! चाचा, ये तो सच में काम करता है!
rows.text: Hahaha! Chacha, this really and truly works!
rows.back_en: Hahaha! Uncle, this really and truly works!

rows.speaker: JUGAADU CHACHA
rows.hi: पर ध्यान रहे, अभी ये पूरी तरह तैयार नहीं है। इसे कोई बाहर नहीं ले जाएगा!
rows.text: But listen, it is not completely ready yet. So nobody should take it outside!
rows.back_en: But listen, it is not completely ready yet. So nobody should take it outside!

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: बिल्कुल नहीं, चाचा!
rows.text: Absolutely not, Chacha!
rows.back_en: Absolutely not, Uncle!

rows.speaker: GUDIYA
rows.hi: बस थोड़ी देर के लिए…
rows.text: Just for a tiny little bit...
rows.back_en: Just for a tiny little bit...

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: मेले में बड़ा मज़ा आएगा!
rows.text: It will be so much fun at the fair!
rows.back_en: It will be so much fun at the fair!

rows.speaker: RAJU
rows.hi: देखो मेरी पतंग! पूरे गाँव में सबसे ऊँची उड़ेगी!
rows.text: Look at my amazing kite! It will fly highest in the whole village!
rows.back_en: Look at my amazing kite! It will fly the highest in the whole village!

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: अच्छा? रेडियो, ज़रा राजू के दिल की सुनाओ!
rows.text: Really? Oh radio, let us hear what is inside Raju's heart!
rows.back_en: Really? Oh radio, let us hear what is in Raju's heart!

rows.speaker: RADIO
rows.hi: गुड़िया मुझसे अच्छी पतंग उड़ाती है… पर ये मैं कभी नहीं मानूँगा!
rows.text: Gudiya flies kites much better than me... but I will never, ever admit this!
rows.back_en: Gudiya flies kites much better than me... but I will never, ever admit this!

rows.speaker: GUDIYA
rows.hi: हाँ! सुना सबने?
rows.text: Yes! Did you all hear?
rows.back_en: Yes! Did you all hear?

rows.speaker: RAJU
rows.hi: अरे! ये… ये तो झूठी मशीन है!
rows.text: Arey! This... this machine is a big liar!
rows.back_en: Hey! This... this machine is a big liar!

rows.speaker: RADIO
rows.hi: प्रसाद में काजू कम पड़ गए… हे भगवान, बस किसी को पता न चले!
rows.text: The cashews are too less in the prasad... Oh my God, I hope nobody finds out!
rows.back_en: There are too few cashews in the offering... Oh my God, I hope nobody finds out!

rows.speaker: GUDIYA
rows.hi: पंडित जी भी!
rows.text: Even Pandit ji!
rows.back_en: Even the priest!

rows.speaker: RADIO
rows.hi: सुबह से एक भी गुब्बारा नहीं बिका… आज घर क्या ले जाऊँगा?
rows.text: Not even one balloon has sold since morning... what will I take back home today?
rows.back_en: I haven't sold even one balloon since morning... what will I take back home today?

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: गुब्बारे वाले भैया उदास हैं…
rows.text: The balloon-wala bhaiya is so sad...
rows.back_en: The balloon seller is so sad...

rows.speaker: GUDIYA
rows.hi: चलो, हम सब अपने पैसों से एक-एक गुब्बारा लेते हैं!
rows.text: Come on, let us buy one balloon each with our own pocket money!
rows.back_en: Come on, let's buy a balloon each with our own pocket money!

rows.speaker: MASTERJI
rows.hi: बच्चो, कल स्कूल समय पर आना। अनुशासन बहुत ज़रूरी है।
rows.text: Children, come to school on time tomorrow. Discipline is extremely important.
rows.back_en: Children, come to school on time tomorrow. Discipline is extremely important.

rows.speaker: RADIO
rows.hi: काश कल भी छुट्टी होती… और मैं दिन भर सोता रहता।
rows.text: I wish tomorrow was a holiday as well... so I could sleep all day long.
rows.back_en: I wish tomorrow was a holiday too... so I could sleep all day long.

rows.speaker: MASTERJI
rows.hi: ये… ये किसकी आवाज़ है?
rows.text: Whose... whose voice is that coming from?
rows.back_en: Whose... whose voice is that coming from?

rows.speaker: LALLAN
rows.hi: वो रहे! उनके हाथ में कोई जादुई डिब्बा है!
rows.text: There they are! They are holding some kind of magic box in their hand!
rows.back_en: There they are! They are holding some kind of magic box in their hands!

rows.speaker: GUDIYA
rows.hi: भागो!
rows.text: Let's run!
rows.back_en: Let's run!

rows.speaker: JUGAADU CHACHA
rows.hi: रुको! वो अभी तैयार नहीं है!
rows.text: Stop! That machine is not fully ready yet!
rows.back_en: Stop! That machine is not fully ready yet!

rows.speaker: RADIO
rows.hi: रेस! मुझे रेस बहुत पसंद है!
rows.text: A race! I really, really love to race!
rows.back_en: A race! I really, really love to race!

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: शेरू, अभी नहीं!
rows.text: Sheru, please not right now!
rows.back_en: Sheru, please not right now!

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: बच गए!
rows.text: We are safe!
rows.back_en: We are safe!

rows.speaker: GUDIYA
rows.hi: लल्लन चाचा का चेहरा देखा था?
rows.text: Did you see the funny look on Lallan Chacha's face?
rows.back_en: Did you see the funny look on Uncle Lallan's face?

rows.speaker: RADIO
rows.hi: सब बड़े हो गए… अब कोई कहानी सुनने नहीं आता।
rows.text: Everyone has grown up so much... now nobody comes to hear my stories.
rows.back_en: Everyone has grown up so much... now nobody comes to listen to my stories.

rows.speaker: RADIO
rows.hi: आज भी बच्चों के लिए लड्डू बनाए थे… पर कोई आया ही नहीं।
rows.text: Today also I made sweet laddus for the children... but nobody came at all.
rows.back_en: Today too, I made sweet treats for the children... but nobody came at all.

rows.speaker: GUDIYA
rows.hi: दादी… अकेली बैठी हैं।
rows.text: Dadi... is sitting all by herself.
rows.back_en: Grandma... is sitting all by herself.

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: सुबह दादी ने बुलाया था… मैंने कहा, "बाद में, दादी।"
rows.text: Dadi had called me in the morning... and I just said, 'Later, Dadi.'
rows.back_en: Grandma called me in the morning... and I just said, 'Later, Grandma.'

rows.speaker: LALLAN
rows.hi: हम सब मेले में थे… और दादी यहाँ अकेली।
rows.text: We were all busy at the fair... and Dadi was here all alone.
rows.back_en: We were all busy at the fair... and Grandma was here all alone.

rows.speaker: MASTERJI
rows.hi: सच ही कहा था रेडियो ने।
rows.text: The radio was absolutely right.
rows.back_en: The radio was absolutely right.

rows.speaker: JUGAADU CHACHA
rows.hi: कुछ बातें रेडियो से नहीं… पास बैठने से सुनाई देती हैं।
rows.text: Some things are not heard on a radio... but by sitting close to each other.
rows.back_en: Some things are not heard on a radio... but by sitting close to each other.

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: दादी! मेला हम आपके पास ले आए!
rows.text: Dadi! Look, we have brought the entire fair to you!
rows.back_en: Grandma! Look, we have brought the entire fair to you!

rows.speaker: DADI
rows.hi: अरे! तुम सब यहाँ? मेला छोड़कर?
rows.text: Arey! All of you came here? Leaving the fair?
rows.back_en: Oh! All of you came here? Leaving the fair?

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: सॉरी दादी। सुबह आपने बुलाया था और मैं नहीं आया।
rows.text: I am sorry, Dadi. You called me in the morning and I did not come.
rows.back_en: I am sorry, Grandma. You called me in the morning and I did not come.

rows.speaker: DADI
rows.hi: अरे पगले… तू आ गया, यही बहुत है।
rows.text: Arey, my silly boy... you came, that is enough.
rows.back_en: Oh, my silly boy... you came, that is enough.

rows.speaker: GUDIYA
rows.hi: दादी, कहानी सुनाइए ना!
rows.text: Dadi, please tell us a story now!
rows.back_en: Grandma, please tell us a story now!

rows.speaker: DADI
rows.hi: तो सुनो… मेरी पहली दिवाली की कहानी। तब इस गाँव में बिजली भी नहीं थी…
rows.text: So listen... the story of my first Diwali. Back then, there was no electricity in our village...
rows.back_en: So listen... the story of my first Diwali. Back then, there was no electricity in our village...

rows.speaker: DADI
rows.hi: उस रात पूरे गाँव में सिर्फ़ दीये जल रहे थे। मेरी दादी हम सब बच्चों को अपने पास बिठातीं…
rows.text: On that night, only diyas were burning in the whole village. My own grandmother would make all of us kids sit close to her...
rows.back_en: On that night, only oil lamps were burning in the whole village. My own grandmother would make all of us kids sit close to her...

rows.speaker: DADI
rows.hi: …और कहतीं — दीया तभी जलता है, जब उसमें प्यार का तेल हो।
rows.text: ...and she would say — a diya only burns when it is filled with the oil of love.
rows.back_en: ...and she would say — an oil lamp only burns when it is filled with the oil of love.

rows.speaker: LALLAN
rows.hi: और ये लीजिए दादी — मेरी मिठाई। आज पूरी चीनी वाली!
rows.text: And please have this, Dadi — my special sweets. Today they have full sugar in them!
rows.back_en: And please have this, Grandma — my special sweets. Today they have the full amount of sugar in them!

rows.speaker: EVERYONE
rows.hi: हाहाहा!
rows.text: Hahaha!
rows.back_en: Hahaha!

rows.speaker: DADI
rows.hi: बच्चो, दिवाली दीयों से नहीं… अपनों के साथ बैठने से रोशन होती है।
rows.text: Children, Diwali is not lit up just by diyas... but by sitting together with your loved ones.
rows.back_en: Children, Diwali is not lit up just by oil lamps... but by sitting together with your loved ones.

rows.speaker: GUDIYA
rows.hi: मास्टरजी, आज कॉपी नहीं — आज दिवाली!
rows.text: Masterji, no notebooks today — today is Diwali!
rows.back_en: Teacher, no notebooks today — today is Diwali!

rows.speaker: MASTERJI
rows.hi: अरे… मेरे लिए दीया? बरसों बाद किसी ने…
rows.text: Arey... a diya for me? After so many years, someone...
rows.back_en: Oh... an oil lamp for me? After so many years, someone...

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: और कल छुट्टी? <short pause> रेडियो ने बताया था!
rows.text: And a holiday tomorrow? <short pause> The radio told us so!
rows.back_en: And a holiday tomorrow? <short pause> The radio told us so!

rows.speaker: MASTERJI
rows.hi: हाहाहा! ठीक है, ठीक है… कल आधी छुट्टी!
rows.text: Hahaha! Okay, okay... half-day holiday tomorrow!
rows.back_en: Hahaha! Okay, okay... a half-day holiday tomorrow!

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: चाचा, सॉरी… हमने आपकी मशीन बिना पूछे ले ली।
rows.text: Chacha, we are sorry... we took your machine without asking you first.
rows.back_en: Uncle, we are sorry... we took your machine without asking you first.

rows.speaker: JUGAADU CHACHA
rows.hi: रेडियो की चिंता नहीं थी, बेटा… दिवाली पर मैं भी तो अकेला था।
rows.text: I was not worried about the radio, beta... on Diwali, even I was feeling so alone.
rows.back_en: I was not worried about the radio, child... on Diwali, even I was feeling so alone.

rows.speaker: GUDIYA
rows.hi: अब नहीं! चलिए, दादी कहानी सुना रही हैं!
rows.text: Not anymore! Come along, Dadi is telling a story now!
rows.back_en: Not anymore! Come along, Grandma is telling a story now!

rows.speaker: JUGAADU CHACHA
rows.hi: सच? चलो चलो! पर पहले… जलेबी!
rows.text: Really? Let's go, let's go! But first... ja-le-bis!
rows.back_en: Really? Let's go, let's go! But first... sweets!

rows.speaker: RADIO
rows.hi: अब तो लड्डू मिलेगा?
rows.text: Will I get my sweet laddu now?
rows.back_en: Will I get my sweet treat now?

rows.speaker: JUGAADU CHACHA
rows.hi: हाहाहा! इसका तो पक्का मिलेगा!
rows.text: Hahaha! You will surely get one for this!
rows.back_en: Hahaha! You will surely get one for this!

rows.speaker: END CARD
rows.hi: बड़ों के साथ समय बिताओ — उन्हें हमारी उतनी ही ज़रूरत है जितनी हमें उनकी।
rows.text: Always spend quality time with your elders — they really need us just as much as we need them in our lives.
rows.back_en: Always spend quality time with your elders — they really need us just as much as we need them in our lives.
